overlapPolicy: Replace OSM if an official form covers >=15% of the OSM footprint or the OSM form covers >=50% of an official footprint. Only >=50% overlap on either side transfers names/uses. Edge-only overlaps retained and counted.
terrainPolicy: Government base/top fields stay absolute HKPD. The current rendered terrain is used only for missing-height/base estimates. Source/terrain conflicts are retained and reported; government heights are not silently lifted.
